usage.source_scope: V4/V5/V7 prior-file-disjoint Commons Development batches with human pixel boxes; V7 uses 12 earlier multi-facet reference views, 32 new queries, six target-building positives, and 26 strong negatives.
usage.project_application: Provide a non-OCR target-to-entrance candidate filter, then convert residual single-frame ambiguity into an explicit closer-view and reacquisition loop before tracking and guidance.
usage.modifications: Reciprocal native DINO support, distractor subtraction, downward structural rays, set-valued authority, two-consecutive-view commit, and last-bearing reacquisition.
usage.expected_effect: Reduce wrong entrance commitments without dropping oracle-available target entrances, then resolve same-frame ambiguity with active evidence rather than a lower threshold.

evaluation.setup: One-shot zero-OCR V7 comparison with source identities, multi-facet references, human target-entrance boxes, native-grid representation, reducer, and gates frozen before inference.
evaluation.effect: Support rays preserved two correct unique commits while reducing false commits from 30 to 7 and increasing precision 3.56x. COMMIT or SET_VALUED retained truth on all four positives for which GroundingDINO supplied an IoU-qualified proposal. Correct unique commits did not increase, so the single-frame locator gate failed and temporal active disambiguation remains mechanics-only.
evaluation.claim_boundary: This supports a non-OCR candidate-preserving veto and an active-observation control seam. It does not establish a finished unique entrance locator, temporal disambiguation, tracking, public access, navigation, arrival, product benefit, user benefit, or safety.

evidence.summary: Frozen V7 multi-facet source, exact target-entrance truth, unchanged algorithm, metrics, and stop rule.
Deterministic ambiguity, closer-view, commit, loss, and reacquisition mechanism.
V4 through V7 metrics, backend receipts, source audit, terminal, next step, and claim boundaries.

history.change: Consumed V4, V5, and V7 without retuning. Retain native support rays only as a candidate-preserving false-commit filter; next evidence must be temporal active-view disambiguation.
